command: pnpm --filter @computesdk/daytona --fail-if-no-match exec vitest run src/__tests__/command-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/lifecycle-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
claims: Named bounded local-shell tests preserve comments, heredocs, exit, stdin EOF, literal cwd/env, and exact text stdout/stderr.
Named tests reject malformed present completion status and preserve an explicit native exit 23 when the delimiter is absent.
Named tests reject absent completion with missing, malformed or zero native status; preserve explicit native failures1..255; and verify fixed typed protocol diagnostics without captured secrets.

Named lifecycle regressions preserve canonical native IDs and every public-get/delete failure; real SDK error classes and a two-stage positive-sandbox/auxiliary404 model prevent false-null and false-idempotent cleanup.
scope: Historical revision-specific local regression evidence, not all-capability or current/future-tree native certification.
limitations: Only named local command and lifecycle regression cases are covered; live native behavior, other operations and full capability coverage remain unverified.
No clean dependency installation or live provider execution was performed; the existing installed dependency store was reused.
Length equality is not a checksum, arbitrary binary integrity, or remote cancellation/cleanup guarantee.
Native zsh/custom images and survival of long-running detached processes remain unverified.
Absent-footer native failures remain failure information only, not proof of child completion or full separated output.

Public get may fail toolbox-proxy hydration after finding the sandbox. No generic404 can safely prove absence; nullable lookup/idempotent missing destroy remain unresolved and cleanup-blocked. Native delete(wait=false) acknowledges acceptance only.
